analysis: The trial succeeded: host validation macro HR@10 reached 0.5363, compared with 0.450 for endpoint-only masking and 0.505 for the stated baseline. Category HR@10 was 0.575 Movies_and_TV, 0.605 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.420 Electronics, and 0.545 CDs_and_Vinyl. CDs_and_Vinyl recovered from 0.335. Results support retaining interior reconstruction supervision, though one trial does not establish causality. Electronics remains the weakest category. Allocated training cost was 290.62 GPU-seconds; no test results were provided.
code_summary: Trains one independent bidirectional MaskedRec network per category: default 96-dimensional embeddings, two attention blocks, two heads, length 64, and dropout 0.25. Training always masks the sampled endpoint and independently masks preceding nonpadding items with probability 0.15. Reconstruction uses at most 768 supervised positions, prioritizing endpoints, with 512 shared uniform negatives and mean sampled-softmax cross-entropy. Scores use normalized embeddings, learned scale, and jointly trained item biases. Synthetic checks cover masking, position caps, and finite loss/gradients while restoring RNG state. Inference appends one mask token and loads exactly one validation-selected checkpoint per category, without averaging or auxiliary scorers. Supplied splits, category routing, seeds, optimizer, and predictor interface are preserved.
